arguments.root_cause_statement: The checkout-api rollout is not stalled by anything in the deployment's own spec. The new ReplicaSet checkout-api-64fb54b496 cannot create even one pod because every pod CREATE in the cluster is sent to the admission webhook "validate.policy-guard.platform.internal" of ValidatingWebhookConfiguration policy-guard, whose clientConfig points at Service policy-guard in namespace platform-policy. That backend no longer exists (the namespace platform-policy is not present in the cluster), the API server's call fails with service "policy-guard" not found, and because the webhook's failure policy rejects on error the create is denied with an Internal error. ReplicaSet checkout-api-64fb54b496 therefore carries ReplicaFailure/FailedCreate and stays at 0 replicas, while the old ReplicaSet checkout-api-8587489575 was already scaled from 3 to 2 by the rolling update (maxUnavailable 1, maxSurge 0), leaving Deployment checkout/checkout-api serving 2 of 3 replicas and Progressing=False with ProgressDeadlineExceeded. The version-number change the team made is incidental; any pod creation in this cluster would fail the same way.
arguments.mechanism: ValidatingWebhookConfiguration policy-guard intercepts pod CREATE and its webhooks[name=validate.policy-guard.platform.internal].clientConfig.service names Service policy-guard in namespace platform-policy, a namespace that does not exist, so the API server call fails with `failed to call webhook: Post "https://policy-guard.platform-policy.svc:443/validate?timeout=10s": service "policy-guard" not found`; with failurePolicy Fail instead of Ignore every such create is rejected as an Internal error, so ReplicaSet checkout-api-64fb54b496 gets `Error creating` on each retry (x15) and reports ReplicaFailure True FailedCreate at 0 current / 1 desired.
